name: Sootopolis City
lines:
You’re a Pokémon Trainer, aren’t you?
Sootopolis’s Gym Leader, Wallace, has a lot of fans.
Do you have any fans?
Ohhh... Then you must be pretty strong.

Oh dear...
That’s kinda sad.
Put a little work into getting your own fan following!

Dedicated fans flock in, even from as far away
as the Kanto and Johto regions.
He must be the coolest Water-type Gym Leader
in the world!
